entry.name: AI Engineering in Python
entry.note: A project-based learning path with a completion certificate, not a proctored exam
entry.audience: Career changers who want to learn by building projects

covers: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and tool use
Data analysis with pandas, NumPy, and matplotlib
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning with scikit-learn
Embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search
reading.format: The path is delivered online with hands-on coding in the browser and guided projects. Learners write code and get feedback directly in the browser.
reading.summary: This path teaches AI engineering skills from Python fundamentals to deploying production AI systems. It covers working with large language models through APIs and prompt engineering, then data analysis, machine learning, and deep learning. Later topics include embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation systems. Learners complete guided projects to build a portfolio of AI applications.
reading.audience: The page describes it as a career path from zero to job-ready in 10 months. It is for people who want to build the technical skills AI engineers need.
